project_type: Vite 8 + React 19 + TypeScript + Tailwind 3 SPA (hrms-frontend), react-router v7, TanStack Query, recharts, @iconify/react with inlined Solar icons
build_system: npm (no package-lock.json; node_modules already installed in the worktree). `npm run build` = `tsc -b && vite build`. tsc -b has 131 pre-existing errors (baseline) so run `npx tsc -b 2>&1 | grep -c 'error TS'` and require <=131 and no new errors in touched files; run `npx vite build` separately to confirm bundling.
test_framework: vitest (vitest.config.ts; 16 tests: src/components/EmptyState/EmptyState.test.ts, src/components/DataTable/useFilterSync.test.ts, others) and Playwright (e2e/smoke.spec.ts, e2e/primitives.spec.ts, fixtures in e2e/fixtures.ts; playwright.config.ts starts vite on :5199 and mocks API with API_BASE_URL http://127.0.0.1:59002)
build_command: npx tsc -b 2>&1 | grep -c 'error TS'  (must be <=131); npx vite build
test_command: npx vitest run; npx oxlint (warnings must be <=294); npx playwright test (34 passing baseline)
verification_instructions: After each FEAT: tsc error count <=131, `npx oxlint` warnings <=294, `npx vitest run` all pass, `npx vite build` ok, `npx playwright test e2e/primitives.spec.ts` passes. FEAT-005 additionally runs the full playwright suite and the screenshot specs with SHOT_NAME=after2.
snapshot_or_generated_files: Screenshots written by e2e/smoke.spec.ts to $SHOT_DIR/$SHOT_NAME (default hrms-minimal-restyle/screens/<name>). Pass 2 must use SHOT_DIR='/Users/admin/Documents/GitHub/Leadspoint CRM/hrms-frontend/.agents/tasks/minimal-ui-pass2/screens' and SHOT_NAME=after2 (screens/before exists already). They live outside the worktree; never commit them.
environment_constraints: Work ONLY in /Users/admin/Documents/GitHub/Leadspoint CRM/hrms-frontend-worktrees/minimal-ui-pass2 (branch minimal-ui-pass2; use git -C). Relative paths land in the parent workspace. Never push or deploy. Do not touch routes, API calls, permissions, handlers, data. Dark mode stays off (keep darkMode:'class' and dark tokens). No MUI. No package-lock.json so no `npm ci`.
contribution_requirements: No functional change: keep Escape/closing behaviour, button `type` semantics (Button defaults type='button'; submit buttons must keep type='submit'), disabled states, aria-labels, permission gates (Can, ActionButton permission). Semantic tokens only; no raw hex/palette classes in src/pages except data-driven colours (list each exception). Reusable components only, no duplication.
key_patterns: Tokens in src/index.css as RGB channels, exposed in tailwind.config.ts as primary/secondary/info/success/warning/error-{lighter,light,main,dark,darker,contrast}, grey-50..900, ink-primary|secondary|disabled, surface-paper|default|neutral, divider, shadow-z1..z24|card|dropdown|dialog|primary.., rounded (8px) and rounded-card (16px). ui primitives live in src/components/ui/<Name>/{Name.tsx,index.ts} and use cx() from ui/cx.ts and FIELD_CLASSES from ui/fieldClasses.ts. Icons: src/components/Iconify/Iconify.tsx (named registry ICONS -> inlined Solar icon objects in solarIcons.ts; add new icons by adding export + ICONS entry; <Iconify icon="name" width={n}/>). Nav icons come from NavItem.icon in src/config/navigation.ts resolved by Layout/NavIcon.tsx. ActionButton already wraps ui/Button (CreateButton/EditButton/DeleteButton). CRUD list pages use createCrudHooks + DataTable + FilterBar + Pagination + CrudModal + ConfirmDialog. ChartWidget (self-fetching) uses getChartColors() from CSS vars. MetricCard (src/components/MetricCard) is link-card used by dashboard/MetricsSection.tsx.
directory_structure: src/pages: 86 top-level *.tsx (mostly DataTable CRUD pages) + subdirs admin, appraisals, attendance, auth, dashboard, employees, expenses, grievances, helpdesk, leaves, onboarding, overtime, payroll, recruitment, settings (29 tabs), settlements, shifts, training, travel. src/components: ui, Layout, Iconify, DataTable, CrudModal, ConfirmDialog, ActionButton, BulkActions, ChartWidget, MetricCard, EmptyState, FormBuilder, Skeleton, WorkflowEngine, leaves. src/router/index.tsx has ~204 path entries.
